# Longda's Interesting World (ilongda.com)

## Description
A technical blog covering database internals (MySQL, OceanBase), machine learning, paper reviews, and software engineering tools. Written primarily in Chinese (zh-CN).

## Author
Longda Feng — Software Engineer at OceanBase
